title: Ice and platform productivity progression preceded Aquilo access

failing_environment.reported_behavior: Ice Productivity unlocked with Space Science on Nauvis even though its observed ice recipe benefit was Aquilo-specific.

reproduction.result: The 3.2.2 Landfill stream owned ice-platform and space-platform-foundation while Ice research lacked cryogenic science. Exact C29 runtime and upgrade fixtures prove the corrected progression and ownership transfer.

root_cause.summary: Aquilo-specific Platform recipes shared the earlier Landfill productivity stream, and Ice Productivity did not treat cryogenic science as an invariant after compatibility science composition.

regression_propositions: Ice Productivity contains cryogenic-science-pack after final science composition
Platform Productivity contains space-science-pack and cryogenic-science-pack but not metallurgic-science-pack
an accepting lab exists for every emitted Ice and Platform science ingredient
ice-platform and space-platform-foundation each have exactly one owner and that owner is recipe-prod-research_platform-1
Landfill Productivity owns neither transferred Platform recipe
an exact 3.2.2 save retains Landfill and Ice levels and current Ice progress while Platform starts unresearched
the upgraded C29 save persists and reloads without duplicate ownership

closure.proof_required: complete C29 candidate aggregate, exact manual acceptance, protected qualification, verified seal, promotion, and published 3.2.3 bytes
